text:
nina: Quick roundup from design walk: updated routing policy editor with a collapsible mini-map, per-snapshot scrubber, and inline validator overlays. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/LMN-routing-v3
omar: like the collapsible mini-map. question: persist collapse per-user or per-policy?
rita: per-user is less surprising on shared links. also keyboard toggle needed for mini-map.
ux-bot: Microcopy suggestion: replace top-banner 'Policy invalid' with 'Validation found issues — review fixes' and add a 'Run snapshot' CTA. Shorten replay CTA to 'Play tokens'.
access-bot: Accessibility reminders: mini-map needs aria-label and focusable control; overlays must trap focus and return it after close; announcer for reorders with aria-live polite; badges require text alternatives and not color-only indicators.
omar: scrubber: default to snapshot stepping; token replay in modal using webworker to avoid blocking UI. provide perf tooltip: 'Token replay may be slow for long outputs.'
nina: preview diffs: show primary/fallback side-by-side collapsed by default; include small metric badges (latency, cost). start with side-by-side, consider semantic diff later.
rita: validators should live on the rule card as a badge with hover summary and an inline pane behind a chevron. keyboard shortcut Alt+V to open.
ux-bot: Animation/UX: when reordering, animate card movement and mini-map viewport; if animations interrupted, snap to final state.
access-bot: Focus guidance: when opening validator pane, focus first actionable; Escape closes and returns focus to rule badge. announce moves: 'Moved rule X from position 4 to 1'.
nina: Action items: omar -> persist mini-map state per-user + animation spec; rita -> finalize copy and tooltip text; access-bot -> post keyboard + SR checklist; nina -> update figma and mark for design review next sync.
omar: will stub API flag include_fallbacks and wire token replay webworker prototype.
nina: thanks everyone. aiming for design+accessibility sign-off next week.
